criteria.demonstration: Inspected RFC3629 scalar/byte constraints are derived separately from backing lifetime and higher-level text claims. Actual live C alias mutation invalidates borrowed encoding without dangling access; composed/decomposed valid examples have distinct scalar counts. Rust positive last-use/owned-copy probes and E0506 live-borrow rejection establish only their declared language boundary.

criteria.criterion: Track input position and remaining continuation count without forming an out-of-range pointer. State storage lifetime and mutation restrictions explicitly, including a safe constructed example where another alias changes a previously validated buffer.

criteria.demonstration: The original complete validator is actually imported. Incremental state retains at most three copied octets, counts only completed scalars and transactionally publishes a whole chunk; invalid suffix, impossible prefix, null/length admission, finalization and cancellation have explicit unchanged-state or clearing semantics. Owner composition imports actual owning_sum clone-before-drop with exact pre/post-allocation failure preservation.
